name: Durian
summary: Durian to eat in season and to carry home. The tourism portal says the harvest runs from April to September. The handbook stresses the red-basalt fruit in Đắk Mil. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, and the 2024 handbook.
taste: The tourism portal says the fruit is fragrant and fatty-sweet. The handbook says the Đắk Mil fruit is sweet and especially fragrant.
howToEat: The tourism portal says the main varieties are Ri 6, Út Thủy from Ben Tre, and Monthong from Thailand, with VietGAP certificates. It says the fruit it calls best grows at trang trại Gia Trung in Gia Nghia and in Đắk Mil. The harvest it prints is April through September.
The handbook says good durian grows mainly on red basalt in Đắk Mil, and that farms and orchards there receive visitors. It does not print the April-to-September window.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đắk Mil, and Gia Trung in Gia Nghia on the tourism portal. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Sau rieng in Dak Nong — April to September, or Dak Mil
seoDescription: Durian. The tourism portal says April to September, Ri 6, Út Thủy, and Monthong. The handbook points to Đắk Mil. A price is Check on arrival.
